description.value: Steel & Oak Brewing Co. is a craft brewery and tasting room in New Westminster producing unfiltered, unpasteurized beer using a blend of North American and German brewing traditions, from dry Irish stouts to hazy IPAs. An on-site food truck offers a full menu of burgers, sandwiches, salads, and snacks — a proper sit-down fuel stop rather than just a drink destination. The brewery also hosts events and offers private keg sales, giving it a lively community feel.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active tasting room and food truck at 1319 3rd Ave, New Westminster, with phone (604) 540-6495; these details are absent from OSM tags. The veggie burger is explicitly labelled '(vegan)' on the menu, confirming plant-based options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Vancouver' but the business is located in New Westminster (1319 3rd Ave, New West per website) — the community tag should be corrected.
OSM record contains no address and no phone number; both were sourced from the website only and could not be cross-confirmed against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established craft brewery with a full food menu and active tasting room in New Westminster; a worthwhile destination stop for touring cyclists seeking food and locally-brewed beer.
